correctness.rationale: The graph has unit-side size M=prod m_i and zero-divisor-side N=prod(m_i+1)-M-1. For support J of z, B_{z,u}=1-prod_{i in J}(1-1_{u_i=-z_i}). Multiplication by the unit group on both sides preserves adjacency, so Gram B^T B has character eigenvectors. Fourier cancellation makes C_z(chi)=0 unless support T subset J; for proper nonempty T the squared row sum yields lambda_T=prod_{i notin T}(m_i^2-m_i+1)-prod_{i notin T}(m_i-1)^2; for T empty the row-degree squared sum yields the stated lambda_empty. Every proper-support eigenvalue is positive (row J=T), and full support is zero with multiplicity F=prod(m_i-1). Hence rank B=M-F and adjacency eigenvalues pair ±sqrt(lambda) with remaining nullity N-M+2F. Independent exact integer Gram matrices checked eight field-product support-size tuples including F_2 factors and repeated supports; these do not replace the general Fourier derivation.
